objective.name: sandbox.dsl.query.read.branch.local
objective.description: Rebuild the local root meaning projection, query one local element, read its detailed meaning, and branch on the returned descriptor value.

#root.role: Use meaning.query to discover one local capacity through the root projection, reuse that selected element in read.meaning, and branch on the returned objective name.

effects.local_projection_refresh: The local root meaning projection is rebuilt before selection.
effects.local_projection_query: The local root meaning projection is queried for one matching element.
effects.local_detailed_meaning_read: The selected element is read through local read.meaning before branching.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one branch-specific terminal response after local projected discovery and local detailed meaning read of the selected element.
invariants: The flow always rebuilds the local root projection before querying it.
The selected projected name is reused in a detailed local read.meaning call before branching.
Exactly one terminal wrapper branch is selected from the detailed local meaning value.
success: On success, the terminal payload is the payload returned by the selected local sandbox.echo branch.
When the detailed objective name resolves to sandbox.echo, the branch message is query-read-local-branch.
failure: The flow fails if the rebuild, query, detailed read, or selected terminal branch cannot complete.
A missing projected or detailed selection closes the scenario fail-closed unless the branch condition still evaluates deterministically.
notes: This scenario demonstrates the intended reflexive composition pattern query -> read.meaning -> branch within one instance.
Projected discovery and detailed descriptor read are intentionally kept distinct.

filters.value: Wrapper-backed echo capacity for N5 inter-instance tests
